spanish: No volveremos a nuestras casas hasta heredar hijos de Israel, varón su heredad.

findings.issue: The hithpael infinitive has בני ישראל as its subject and איש נחלתו as the holding received; 'heredar hijos de Israel' makes the sons the object and leaves the 'we' of volveremos as the ones who inherit.
findings.spanishSpan: heredar hijos de Israel, varón su heredad

notes: No volveremos a nuestras casas matches the negative, qal 1cp, אל, and our houses.
